command: cd clients/python && python3 -m pytest tests/test_round_trips.py -q --no-header -p no:cacheprovider

cases.name: the floor is never sent
cases.old:
implied = self._watermark.freshness()
        return None if implied is None else implied.to_proto()
cases.new:
implied = self._watermark.freshness()
        return None if implied is not None else implied

cases.name: a write stops advancing the watermark
cases.old:
def _observe(self, sequence: int | None) -> None:
        self._watermark.observe(sequence)
cases.new:
def _observe(self, sequence: int | None) -> None:
        self._watermark.observe(None)

cases.name: the floor is gated on monotonic_reads, as Go and TypeScript gate it
cases.old:
implied = self._watermark.freshness()
        return None if implied is None else implied.to_proto()
cases.new:
implied = self._watermark.freshness() if self._monotonic_reads else None
        return None if implied is None else implied.to_proto()
